content.user_title: Generate and Pre-Score Email Subject Lines
content.value_statement: Weak subject lines waste test traffic and may hide the main promise on mobile. This skill creates ranked variants with transparent pre-send checks.
actual_capabilities: Generates three to eight subject and preheader pairs across distinct marketing angles.
Assigns stable variant identifiers and angle labels for later testing.
Counts characters and estimates desktop and mobile truncation.
Flags common spam patterns, deceptive prefixes, symbol stacking, and unsupported scarcity.
Counts emoji and applies different rules for promotional, newsletter, and cold-outbound modes.
Renders inbox previews and ranks candidates with stated reasons.
limitations: Heuristic checks cannot guarantee inbox placement or mailbox-provider treatment.
The skill does not verify SPF, DKIM, DMARC, or full email body content.
It does not design experiments, calculate statistical significance, or compute email quality scores.
Truncation limits are estimates because email clients and devices render text differently.

use_cases.title: Prepare Promotional Tests
use_cases.description: Create offer-focused variants, inspect mobile promise visibility, and shortlist candidates before allocating campaign traffic.

use_cases.title: Review Cold Outreach
use_cases.description: Check concise B2B subjects for deceptive prefixes, emoji use, spam patterns, and weak preheader alignment.

use_cases.title: Improve Newsletter Opens
use_cases.description: Compare curiosity, benefit, and question angles while preserving clear inbox previews across desktop and mobile.

prompt_templates.title: Check One Subject
prompt_templates.prompt: Pre-score this subject and preheader in newsletter mode. Show character counts, spam flags, emoji count, and desktop and mobile previews: [paste text].
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one existing pair

prompt_templates.title: Generate Variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate five subject and preheader pairs for [offer]. Use promo mode, label each angle, pre-score every pair, and rank the strongest options.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a new promotional variant set

prompt_templates.title: Compare Existing Candidates
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate these subject candidates for [audience] in cold-outbound mode: [paste list]. Draft matching preheaders, explain every cut, and preserve stable variant identifiers.

prompt_templates.title: Use Campaign Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these past campaign subjects and results: [paste export]. Generate six new variants for [objective], label evidence and estimates, then recommend a test-ready shortlist.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced generation informed by historical campaign data

output_examples.input: Generate three newsletter subjects for a monthly product update.
output: SUBJ-A, Benefit: Three improvements that save time this month
SUBJ-B, Curiosity: What changed in your workspace this month?
SUBJ-C, Direct: Your July product update is ready
Recommendation: Advance SUBJ-A and SUBJ-C. Test SUBJ-B after clarifying the preview promise.

output_examples.input: Pre-score: RE: Last chance!!! Save 50% today
output_examples.output: Cut this variant. It uses a deceptive reply prefix, stacked exclamation marks, urgency, and several promotional signals. Verify the discount before rewriting.

output_examples.input: Preview a mobile subject: Build faster workflows with the new automation dashboard
output_examples.output: The estimated mobile preview truncates before the main product detail. Move the automation benefit earlier and use the preheader for supporting context.

best_practices: Provide the audience, campaign mode, offer, from-name, and any verified claim details.
Treat character counts as measured data and render or spam limits as estimates.
Test shortlisted variants with one controlled change per test cell.
anti_patterns: Do not present a clean heuristic result as an inbox-placement guarantee.
Do not invent prices, discounts, statistics, scarcity, or personalization data.
Do not optimize the subject without checking how the paired preheader extends it.

faq.question: Does this skill guarantee inbox placement?
faq.answer: No. It flags subject-level patterns, but mailbox filtering also depends on authentication, reputation, content, and provider-specific systems.

faq.question: Can it write the full email?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on subject lines, preheaders, ranking, and inbox previews.

faq.question: How many variants does it create?
faq.answer: It normally creates three to eight variants with stable identifiers and distinct angle labels.

faq.question: Does it support cold outreach?
faq.answer: Yes. Cold-outbound mode applies stricter emoji and tone checks than promotional or newsletter modes.

faq.question: Are truncation limits exact?
faq.answer: No. Character counts are exact, but visible length varies by client, device, font, and sender information.

faq.question: Can it use past campaign performance?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide a manual export of subjects and results so it can identify relevant angle and length patterns.
